title: Major update of Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) is available for existing customers
summary: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) is now generally available for existing customers to update. The post explains the update scheduling process through the Admin Center, where customers can set their update date within a flexible 5-month window, with a mandatory deadline of September 1, 2026.
key_points: BC28 (version 28.0) is the major update for 2026 release wave 1, available starting April 2026
Customers can schedule and reschedule their update date flexibly through the Business Central Admin Center
The update window is 5 months long, with a mandatory deadline of September 1, 2026 for all environments
Obsolete code is marked 12 months before removal to give developers time to migrate
Notification emails inform customers of their scheduled update dates and allow modification through the Admin Center

quotes.text: Yes, the major update of Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28) is available for existing customers.
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms BC28 general availability and the start of the update rollout

quotes.text: You can reschedule this update for any date within the update period or choose a different version to update your environment to next.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the flexible update management capability that replaced the rigid 30-60 day window

quotes.text: When an object is marked as obsolete, another 12 months will pass before the code is removed, in some cases even longer.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important for developers to understand the deprecation timeline for obsolete objects
